This isn't a winning/losing situation. Online interaction isn't a contest, it's socializing. I don't know if I have an answer for stopping harassment, but I'm not sure if there is an answer either. People are dicks online and in person. Sure it's easier to be a dick online, and at the receiving end of a death/rape threat it is very hard to tell the difference between idle and genuine threats, but trying to force social change is a slippery slope. They (reddit and others) can't both be the message board and moral authority. They can't be a champion for free speech and then define what speech should be free both. If they want to make a choice that's fine, but that choice may ultimately remove them consideration as any form of moral authority.
